description: Enjoy secure back-up of all your data with the efficient and utilitarian Western Digital 5 TB Portable Hard Disk Drive (HDD). The HDD comes with a 5 TB capacity that allows you to store a huge volume of data so that you never have to compromise and delete certain things to accommodate newer data. The USB 3.2 Gen 1 interface allows easy transmission of data which makes it useful for transferring huge amount of data. FROM THE MANUFACTURER Slim style Make the most of your journey with style that suits you. The new My Passport has been redesigned to feature a convenient, slim form factor and is available in a range of vibrant colors. * This Western Digital My Passport HDD image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Backed up Make sure everything you create while on your own life journey - photos, videos, music, and documents - doesn’t get lost. The My Passport drive comes equipped with WD Backup software that can be set to run automatically to your schedule. Just pick the time and frequency to back up important files from your system onto your My Passport drive. * This Western Digital My Passport HDD image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Lock
